summary.text: Dennis Mannion is a Republican member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives from Rockingham 25 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election after advancing from the September 8 primary.
Mannion has worked as a law enforcement officer, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Dennis Mannion lives in Salem, New Hampshire, and graduated from Greater Lawrence Regional Vocational Technical High School.
His career experience includes working as a law enforcement officer.
Ballotpedia lists Mannion's tenure in the New Hampshire House of Representatives as beginning in 2022.
